title: Didn’t work
text: Didn’t work. Looked up carafe model from the back of my coffee maker and listing said it would work. It doesn’t. The rounded top is much bigger than the one that comes on the original carafe. It knocks the coffee filter holder off-kilter inside the coffee maker and coffee grounds get into the coffee.
